title: KitchenAid Go vs Corded Hand Blender in Australia: When Is the Battery Bundle Worth It?

Show the entire unbranded blender, with its lower shaft and bell visible through the clear side of the jug, and the person's face and hands entirely inside the frame. The blender has a plain smooth matte housing and a simple stainless steel shaft of realistic proportions, with controls turned away and no likeness to a specific commercial model. Add soft daylight from a side window and generous margins. Prefer a horizontal 16:9 composition, ideally 1200 by 675. No letters, fake brand markings, logos, numbers, digital display text, control labels, symbols, captions, infographic panels or collage.
